all_in_and_amortized_summary_cal.cohort: 19 untouched calibration orgs (mean ~182 KB/org, 38 horizon deployments)

two_stage_protocol.barber_et_al_pitfall_note: Leave-one-organization-out (LOLO) residuals evaluate a different refitted predictor on each fold rather than the single shipped predictor, breaking split-conformal exchangeability (Barber et al., arXiv:1905.02928). A1b therefore uses a strict two-stage split-conformal protocol: Stage 1 fits and locks ONE predictor strictly on the 6 predictor-fit orgs (zero calibration data); Stage 2 evaluates that EXACT locked predictor (verified by SHA-256) once on each of 19 untouched independent calibration orgs (rank k = 18/19, tolerating 1 outlier at alpha=0.10 rather than degenerating to the sample maximum). Post-selection switching to a different predictor on the same calibration set is NOT certified.

stage2_split_conformal_calibration.nonconformity_definition: s_i = max(full_oracle_regret_100KB(i), full_oracle_regret_100MB(i)) against full 7-chain selector-by-K oracle

conformal_selection_audit.note: Certifies strictly the ONE unconditional Stage-1 locked predictor. 3-pt pilot UPB is reported solely as a separate non-adaptive benchmark comparator; conditionally switching predictors on the same calibration set without multiplicity correction breaks unadjusted 90% finite-sample split-conformal validity.

stage1_lolo_diagnostic_only_not_conforma.note: Diagnostic Stage-1 LOLO-CV on the 6 predictor-fit orgs ONLY; NOT valid for split-conformal coverage (Barber et al., arXiv:1905.02928).

all_in_and_amortized_work.denominator_flaw_note: The prior headline 0.112x wall ratio used only per-query same-chain grid evaluation as denominator and omitted `shared_chain_build_sec` (~266 s to build the deployed exact_closed chain + fit its 10 B1RA code tables + lock the Stage-1 predictor). This table reports honest single-deployment (N=1) and amortized multi-deployment (N in {1, 2, 5, 10, 50}) all-in ratios against BOTH same-chain grid/pilot AND full_multichain_grid (building + grid-searching all 7 selector chains).
